summary: Drive resource preparation from its pending queue instead of scanning all claims, including when the queue is empty.

replay.detail: No replay or preparation-version change. Existing queued claims retain the complete canonical order; empty queues no longer visit claims.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change; no coordinated member upgrade is required.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, provider admission or persisted representation change.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the ordinary binary restart. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health on an affected large store have not been measured.

manual.detail: No manual migration or repair is required; existing pending work is consumed on the normal preparation path after upgrading.

recovery.detail: This query-only change introduces no migration or additional swap-back restriction; the old binary may exhibit the original full-claims scan.
